item.title: JWT Login Authentication
item.description: Session Technology Session: When a user opens a browser and accesses web server resources, a session is established. It ends when either side disconnects. A single session can include multiple requests and responses. Session Tracking: A method to maintain browser state. The server needs to identify if multiple requests come from the same browser to share data across these requests within the same session.
